| BUDDHA BOWL IDEAS | BOWL IDEAS

A Buddha bow is a big bow! of food, piled up with a rounded “belly” on
top, much like the belly of Buddha. They are popular with not only vegans
and vegetarians, but also anyone looking for a wholesome meal in a bowl.
Depending on what you toss into the bowl, it can be savory, sweet, spicy,
warm, or cold. Depending on when you eat the bowl, it could be break-
fast, lunch, or dinner. Because of the varying ingredients, we are unable
to include nutrition information with this recipe.

1. To create your Buddha bowl, start with a wholesome grain as the
first layer: quinoa, (brown) rice, farro.

2. Add roasted vegetables: bite-size chunks of roasted winter squash,
beets, brussels sprouts, carrots, cauliflower, broccoli, sweet potato,
kale.

3. Add raw greens: spinach, kale, arugula.

4. Add fruit: diced avocado, apple, pear, craisins, berries, raisins.
